documents.proposal:
# Proposal: Add epic-list circuit-breaker + disk advisory

Extend the disk-authoritative pattern from `epics.get` to the Epic list/convergence path:
- Apply the per-request circuit-breaker (K=3 consecutive unresponsive) to list-side per-Epic queries.
- Add list-side disk-projection advisory fallback (analogous to the change-side `loadCandidate` two-leg pattern) so a wedged Epic workflow degrades to advisory, never hangs/drops.
- Add list-side CB + disk-fallback test coverage (finding test-coverage-1).

Fast-follow of makeReadsDiskAuthoritative (shipped). Epic hardenTemporalReliability invariant #1, list surface.
documents.problemStatement:
# Problem: Epic list reads lack circuit-breaker + disk fallback

The shipped disk-authoritative fix (makeReadsDiskAuthoritative, commit 1879fb64) covered `epics.get` (single-Epic read) with deadline threading + disk-first leg + advisory, but the Epic LIST read path (`adv_epic_list` / list-side convergence in `plugin/src/storage/store-temporal/epics.ts` ~line 607) still issues serial per-Epic workflow queries with no per-request circuit-breaker and no disk-advisory fallback. A cluster of unresponsive Epic workflows can still consume the aggregate read budget; retired projections may be dropped.

Found by adv-reviewer acceptance review (finding epic-read-1, 2026-07-23) of makeReadsDiskAuthoritative. Same defect class (Epic hardenTemporalReliability invariant #1), list surface not yet covered.
documents.agreement:
# Agreement: Add epic-list circuit-breaker

## Objectives
1. Thread ONE shared `TemporalReadContext` through the epic convergence paths (`convergeEpicOnShow`, `enrichEpicRenderWithFastFollowLineage`, `epics.list`) so K=3 consecutive unresponsive children trip the shipped circuit-breaker once.
2. `store.changes.get` accepts an optional `{context?}` and forwards it to `getTemporalChange` (omitted = unchanged fresh-ctx behavior).
3. `tryQueryEpicStateRead` records responsive/unresponsive on the shared ctx so `epics.list`'s existing ctx actually trips.
4. `epics.list` short-circuits remaining queries once the CB trips or the deadline expires.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: `store.changes.get(changeId, {context})` forwards the supplied ctx to `getTemporalChange`; omitted = fresh ctx (no behavior change for existing callers).
- AC2: `convergeEpicOnShow` shares one CB ctx across members; with ≥4 unresponsive members the show returns within budget (≪10s) with tripped members degraded to disk+advisory, not unreachable.
- AC3: `epics.list` short-circuits after K=3 consecutive unresponsive Epics (5 hanging → 3 query attempts, bounded elapsed).
- AC4: `tryQueryEpicStateRead` calls `recordResponsiveMember` on success and `recordUnresponsiveMember` on timeout; `not_found` is neutral.
- AC5: `enrichEpicRenderWithFastFollowLineage` shares the CB and short-circuits on trip.

## Constraints
- Reuse the shipped CB on `TemporalReadContext` + `workflow_unresponsive` taxonomy — do NOT invent a second CB.
- Fix surface: `tools/` + `storage/store-temporal/` only; `workflows.ts` untouched (replay-safe; boundary tests enforce).
- `pnpm run check` + `pnpm run build` green; optional-param change is backward-compatible (impls taking fewer params stay assignable).

## Avoidances
- Do not change `getTemporalChange` semantics (it already short-circuits + records when given a shared ctx).
- Do not regress existing `store.changes.get` callers that omit ctx.
- Do not emit `kind:"unreachable"` for a CB-tripped member that has a disk projection (must be `present`+advisory).

Fast-follow of makeReadsDiskAuthoritative. Epic hardenTemporalReliability invariant #1, epic-show/list surface (closes review finding epic-read-1).
documents.design:
# Design: epic-list circuit-breaker

## Decision
Thread ONE shared `TemporalReadContext` through the epic convergence paths so the shipped circuit-breaker (K=3) accumulates across members. `getTemporalChange` already short-circuits + records when given a shared ctx — this change just plumbs the ctx through.

## Changes (shipped 7de2cd0b)
1. `store-types.ts` + `changes.ts`: `store.changes.get` accepts optional `{context?: TemporalReadContext}`; forwards to `getTemporalChange`. Omitted = fresh ctx (backward-compatible; disk-store impls ignore the param).
2. `tools/epic.ts convergeEpicOnShow`: build one `convergenceCtx`, thread through `loadChange`; getTemporalChange short-circuits tripped members to disk+`workflow_unresponsive` advisory (present, not unreachable).
3. `tools/epic.ts buildFastFollowLineageMap`: own ctx + short-circuit on trip.
4. `storage/store-temporal/epics.ts tryQueryEpicStateRead`: record responsive/unresponsive on the shared ctx (mirror index.ts:901/939); `epics.list` short-circuits on `isCircuitBreakerTripped()`/`isTemporalReadExpired()`.

## LBP / structural correctness
- Reuses the typed CB state machine + `workflow_unresponsive` reason — no second CB, no heuristic.
- Mutation-safety preserved: tripped members return disk+advisory (read-only); getTemporalChange's no-reseed guarantee unchanged.

## Replay verdict
NOT replay-sensitive: tools/ + storage/store-temporal/ only; `workflows.ts` untouched (boundary tests enforce).

## Independent validation
adv-tron recon (2026-07-23) served as independent architectural validation; fast-track per user approval.
documents.executiveSummary:
# Executive Summary: epic-list circuit-breaker

## Outcome
`adv_epic_show` and `adv_epic_list` no longer hang when epic member workflows are unresponsive. The shipped change-side circuit-breaker now threads through the epic convergence paths: after K=3 consecutive unresponsive members, remaining queries short-circuit to disk+advisory instead of each burning the 1500ms per-member cap.

## Why it matters
Closes the epic-side half of the read-wedge (review finding epic-read-1 of makeReadsDiskAuthoritative). Before this, `adv_change_list` was protected but `adv_epic_show`/`adv_epic_list` allocated a fresh `TemporalReadContext` per member, so the CB never tripped and a cluster of wedged Epic workflows could exceed the 10s tool budget. Epic `hardenTemporalReliability` invariant #1 is now fully covered across change-side AND epic-side reads.

## What was delivered
- `store.changes.get` accepts an optional `{context?}`, forwarding a shared ctx to `getTemporalChange` (backward-compatible).
- `convergeEpicOnShow` + `buildFastFollowLineageMap` each build/share one CB ctx across their member loops.
- `tryQueryEpicStateRead` records responsive/unresponsive on the shared ctx; `epics.list` short-circuits on CB trip / deadline expiry.

## Verification
- `pnpm run check` + `pnpm run build` green; 203+ tests pass including new `epics.list` CB-trip regression (5 hanging epics → 3 query attempts, bounded elapsed).
- Live verification (2026-07-23): post-deploy+restart, `adv_epic_show`/`adv_epic_list` return fast, zero `ToolExecutionTimeout`.
- Replay-safe: `workflows.ts` untouched; boundary tests enforce.

## Risks / follow-ups
- Reuses the shipped CB; no new failure mode introduced.
- `fixHealthDegradedAlive` (sibling follow-up, the probe_degraded inverse concern) remains open — lower urgency.

## Release readiness
Merged to trunk (`7de2cd0b`), deployed, restarted, verified live. Safe to release — strictly extends read resilience to the epic surface.
